facts.text: The resort is on the southern tip of Seven Mile Beach.
facts.excerpt: Ideally situated on the southern tip of Seven Mile Beach

facts.text: The resort is 10 minutes from Owen Roberts International Airport.
facts.excerpt: just 10 minutes from Owen Roberts International Airport

facts.text: Mera Spa has 14 indoor and outdoor treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: in our serene, luxurious spa with 14 indoor and outdoor rooms and a host of treatments, massages and experiences to choose from

facts.text: The resort has oceanfront pools, including a family pool, the spa's vitality pool and a main pool with a swim-up bar.
facts.excerpt: Our oceanfront pools are thoughtfully designed for a variety of moments—playful for family fun, restorative calm in the spa’s vitality pool and refined relaxation at the main pool with handcrafted cocktails served from our swim-up bar.

facts.text: Many rooms and suites have balconies and ocean views and can connect to adjoining rooms.
facts.excerpt: Many of our rooms and suites feature balconies and ocean views and can be connected to adjoining rooms

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and natural decor.
facts.excerpt: enhanced with natural decor, one king bed, a seating area with armchair, chaise and coffee table, thoughtful amenities and charming views of the island through floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: The 3 Bedroom Silver Thatch Residence is an oceanfront suite with a kitchen and an oversize furnished terrace.
facts.excerpt: a living room with a sleeper sofa, a dining room, a kitchen, an additional full bathroom and an oversize terrace, 2221 square feet, with furnished sitting and dining areas

facts.text: Some oceanfront suites have a full kitchen and a dining table seating six.
facts.excerpt: a full kitchen, a dining table seating six and a large furnished balcony offering 256 to 290 square feet of island-style relaxation, set against views of the sea

facts.text: Grand Club guests get daily breakfast in an indoor lounge with an oceanfront terrace and an evening cocktail hour.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive to Grand Club guests, enjoy daily breakfast in an elegant indoor lounge, complemented by an oceanfront terrace with refined dining and lounge seating.

facts.text: Camp Hyatt offers marine-themed activities for children ages 4 to 12.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to Camp Hyatt—a playful and engaging experience for children ages 4–12. With a thoughtfully planned selection of daily activities, campers can enjoy marine-themed adventures, arts and crafts

facts.text: Hi Tide is a terrace cevicheria perched above Lo Tide, designed for watching Cayman sunsets.
facts.excerpt: Perched above Lo Tide, Hi Tide is a terrace lounge designed for savoring the famed Cayman sunsets. This stylish cevichería serves a vibrant selection of distinctive ceviches

facts.text: Salt + Cinder is a globally inspired restaurant built around cooking with water and fire.
facts.excerpt: Salt + Cinder is a globally inspired restaurant that celebrates the art of cooking through the primal elements of water and fire.

facts.text: Resort activities include nonmotorized water sports such as kayaks and stand-up paddleboards, plus snorkeling gear.
facts.excerpt: Nonmotorized water sports equipment (kayak, standing paddle board, floating raft, water tricycle)

facts.text: The resort offers local cultural experiences such as marine life sessions for children and thatch art.
facts.excerpt: Local cultural experiences (activities will vary and may include: Cayman marine life educational sessions for children, custom souvenir making, sessions with local craftsman, thatch art and coasters, local flora educational sessions)

facts.text: Dogs and cats under 70 pounds are welcome, up to two per reservation, at no charge.
facts.excerpt: Dogs and cats weighing under 70 pounds and a maximum number of two pets per reservation are permitted complimentary during your stay.

facts.text: Valet parking is free for guests.
facts.excerpt: Our guests may use our valet parking service at no charge.

facts.text: The fitness center has cardio and weight training equipment and space for yoga.
facts.excerpt: Our modern fitness center has you covered with the latest cardio and weight training equipment, plus plenty of space for yoga and more.

facts.text: The hotel describes captivating art, architecture and design.
facts.excerpt: Captivating art, architecture and design frame every moment while imaginative dining thrills the senses.

facts.text: Brasa, an open-flame Caribbean grill, is listed as opening in 2027.
